name: color-space

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert channel values between any two of the 168 color spaces, identity included, in each space's conventional ranges (rgb 0-255, oklch L 0-1 / C 0-0.4 / H 0-360, lab L 0-100 …). One color as `values`, or a batch as `colors`. Out-of-range in, unclamped out: `inRange` flags each channel against the target's conventional range (rgb below 0 means outside sRGB); null = undefined at that coordinate.

from.description: source space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

to.description: target space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

values.description: one color in the source space, e.g. [255, 128, 0] for rgb

colors.description: a batch instead of `values`: one tuple per color, e.g. [[255, 128, 0], [0, 255, 128]]

tools.name: gamut
tools.description: Which standard display gamuts hold a color — sRGB ⊂ Display P3 ⊂ Rec. 2020, each tested in its own RGB box straight from the source space, the same ladder as the color-space.io gamut pill. `smallest` is the tightest one; null = beyond Rec. 2020. Membership only: nothing is gamut-mapped.

from.description: source space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

values.description: one color in the source space

tools.name: css
tools.description: A color as CSS Color 4 strings — rgb(), hsl(), hwb(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch() and color(display-p3 | a98-rgb | prophoto-rgb | srgb-linear | xyz-d65 | xyz-d50) — plus #hex inside sRGB. Converted, never gamut-mapped: a string is null where CSS would clamp it into a different color (rgb/hsl/hwb outside sRGB, lightness out of range). `gamut` is the smallest display gamut that holds the color.

from.description: source space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

values.description: one color in the source space

notations.description: only these, by library space id (default: all)

tools.name: space
tools.description: The dossier of one color space: display name (as color-space.io shows it), description, channels + conventional ranges, defining references, provenance (year, author), illuminant/observer, encoding class, family and purpose, and its direct conversion neighbours.

name.description: the space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

tools.name: spaces
tools.description: List the 168 color spaces with display name, family, purpose, channels and one-line use. Optional filters: `query` (words matched against id, name, use line and description; best matches first), `family`, `purpose`.

tools.name: cube
tools.description: Render a conversion as a .cube LUT file (Resolve, Premiere, Final Cut, OBS, ffmpeg). The header carries the measured deviation vs the direct conversion. Pure per-channel transfers auto-emit 1D. Size ≤ 33 here (larger via the library or https://color-space.io/).

from.description: source space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

to.description: target space id, e.g. 'rgb', 'oklch', 'lab', 'slog3', 'rec709' (the 'spaces' tool lists all 168)

instructions: Verified color conversions between 168 spaces — call these instead of computing color math yourself. `convert` any pair (batches too; flags values outside the target's range), `gamut` for which display gamut holds a color, `css` for CSS Color 4 strings, `space` / `spaces` for references, ranges and provenance, `cube` for a .cube LUT.
